environment: Apple M3 Pro, Node 24.7, pnpm 10.15.1, Vite 7.3.6; Playwright Chrome and standalone WebKit 605.1.15; existing local Vite server serves static production assets
notes: Distribution bytes exclude source maps; gzipBytes is the sum of independently gzip-compressed files, not an installer or VSIX size.
Desktop baseline already includes its previous post-build deduplication; other hosts did not have that pass.
The first prototype build used stale intermediate package output and is excluded. Final host builds consume the freshly built shared package.
Five alternating browser pairs; local HTTP/OS caches are warm. First worker result is not native cold-launch TTI. No memory or FPS improvement is inferred.
Language cases use the complete 332-name registry. Every case yields spans, never fallback text; both phases match exactly in both browsers and all three host builds.

Normal UI screenshots use fresh worker URLs and assert all five workers can use WASM. An earlier WebKit comparison retained a restrictive CSP-test worker response on one side; that unmatched-engine comparison is excluded.
CSP checks also verify both workers actually reject WASM compilation and compare cold typed-source output. No product CSP was changed.
Native foreground and Windows host validation remain outstanding. Desktop status reports not running; standalone browser checks are not native app screenshots.

Final constructor correction preserves importability without Worker. All statically/dynamically imported worker JS files are byte-identical to the browser-tested assets in each host; the production constructor has separate emitted-code tests.
